name: Bifrost network-effect boundaries
description: Configurable forbidden-network-effect specializations. Each policy asserts that every declaration a reviewed declaration-selection document selects reaches no declared network effect, directly or through workspace helpers. The effect is declared by a reviewed semantic model on the exact API identity; purity is never inferred from a name, a file name, a comment, or an unqualified annotation. The policies are opt-in, and a missing or invalid selection document fails activation instead of passing.

policies.severity_rationale: A declaration the repository reviewed as a pure calculation reaching network I/O breaks the boundary the review relied on and can turn a local computation into an externally visible side effect.
policies.remediation: Move the effect to the caller, or make the selected declaration's helper chain reach no declared network effect. Configure the reviewed declaration-selection document `.bifrost/effect-boundaries/csharp-network-io.rqlp` with the exact declarations this repository protects.
